notes.processed_at: First COMPLETED sacct End since 2026-10-01, matching feeder/dashboard.py; when sacct has no completed record, the final_cat_<batch>.hdf5 mtime is used. Only batches with a final catalogue completed on or after 2026-10-10 are included.
notes.published_at: Approximate: historical frozen campaign-list snapshots were not retained. Current published membership comes from feeder/built.txt. For each included batch, the first successful sp-latest job whose Start followed its check-report mtime is used, with the job End as published_at; smk-b01 through smk-b38 are treated as eligible from 2026-10-10 because feeder/batch_order.py admits them unconditionally. A null value means the batch is not in the current successful build or no successful build event could be reconstructed.
notes.latest_winner_rule: latest/ uses the last matching campaign in feeder/built.txt for a tile, following feeder/batch_order.py (numeric batch order; Nibi before Fir for equal numbers). The manifest records per-campaign winning counts, not tile-level winner IDs; latest_winner_by_tile is reconstructed from the ordered campaign lists and tile lists.

sources.tile_id: DR6 tiles_r.txt IDs intersected with each campaign tiles.txt; Nibi chunk .batches is a fallback if needed; Fir uses installed fir-b*/tiles.txt and requires a feeder/imports receipt.
sources.batch_id: Production campaign directory names matching smk-bNNN or fir-bNNNN.
sources.cluster: Campaign prefix: smk -> nibi; fir -> fir.
sources.processed_at: sacct COMPLETED End, falling back to final catalogue mtime, as in feeder/dashboard.py.
sources.published_at: Successful sp-latest sacct Start/End plus campaign check-report mtimes and the successful input list in feeder/built.txt; approximate because historical input lists are absent.
